Subject: Performance & Latency Benchmark Readout — scheduling

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time to evaluate Redwood. Per our discovery last week, the customer engineering team wanted a focused readout of the performance/latency benchmark results and to walk through the end-to-end run so your engineers and procurement/security teams can validate the setup. We’d like to include:

- 30–45 minute technical readout (results + methodology) led by our SE (Dylan)
- 15 minute Q&A with your engineering and security leads
- Procurement brief (contract/SLAs) if needed — happy to include in the same meeting or a follow-up

Proposed windows (PST):
- Wed Feb 18, 10:00–11:00 AM
- Thu Feb 19, 1:00–2:00 PM
- Fri Feb 20, 9:00–10:00 AM

Please let me know which slot works for you and which of your team we should invite (I can add procurement/security contacts once you confirm).

Attached: acme_benchmark_plan.pdf — overview of the test harness, datasets, and metrics we’ll review.

If another day/time works better we can reshuffle — we know there are several stakeholders to coordinate.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: acme_benchmark_plan.pdf (application/pdf)
